question:
Choose the word that is opposite in meaning to the given word.

Strong
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Strong"** means having the power to move heavy weights or perform other physically demanding tasks; able to withstand great force or pressure. (मज़बूत)

 
 
• **Example: **He is** strong** enough to lift those heavy boxes without any help.
 
 
 
• **"Delicate"** refers to something that is easily broken or damaged; fragile. (नाज़ुक)
 
 
• **Example: **The** delicate** vase shattered into pieces when it fell off the shelf.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Strong'** is **'Delicate'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Quick **(तेज़): Moving fast or doing something in a short time.

 
 
• **Example:** She gave a **quick** response to the question.
 
 
 
• **Lazy **(आलसी): Unwilling to work or use energy.
 
 
• **Example: **He is too **lazy** to clean his room.
 
 
 
• **Boring** (उबाऊ): Not interesting; tedious.
 
 
• **Example:** The lecture was so** boring** that many students fell asleep.
